input.encoding: Each node is a signed 32-bit value, a left child index, and a right child index. Child index -1 means absent.
input.root_index: The root may be any node-table index; an empty tree uses -1.
input.valid_tree: A nonempty input is one rooted binary tree: every nonroot node has exactly one parent and all nodes are reachable from the root.
input.result: 1 for mirror symmetry, 0 for asymmetry, -1 for an invalid root or an invalid child index encountered during comparison.
